profile.headline: Associate Project Manager at MJH Life Sciences®
profile.summary:
I am starting a new position as an Associate Project Manager at MJH Life Sciences with a background in technology, project coordination, and cross-functional collaboration. I previously worked as an iOS Developer at the Monmouth University Urban Coast Institute, where I supported the development of a mobile application for the Mid-Atlantic Regional Council on the Ocean’s online data portal.

I hold a B.A. in Computer Science from Monmouth University’s Honors School, with minors in Homeland Security and Geographic Information Systems. My technical background has strengthened my problem-solving and analytical skills, while my project experience has developed my communication, organization, and time management abilities.

I’m passionate about bringing these skills together to help teams stay organized, solve problems, and successfully deliver projects.

positions.title: Associate Project Manager
positions.locationName: Cranbury, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Developer- iOS
positions.description: Continuing development and publication of an iOS mobile app version of the Mid-Atlantic Ocean Data Portal website. This app will be used for marine planning and give users the ability to search data layers, see map visualizations, data summaries, and more, all from their mobile device.

positions.title: IT Cybersecurity Analyst
positions.description:
•	Conducted security assessments to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities, enhancing data and system security
•	Engineered custom scripts to streamline data collection, enhancing efficiency and ensuring accurate log assessments
•	Utilized advanced platforms such as Splunk, Cribl, and Tanium to analyze data and detect/resolve security incidents 
•	Employed Tanium to write queries for data collection, retrieving information about all installed software on devices
•	Formatted and organized the collected data using Cribl, then brought the data into Splunk
•	Developed processes within Splunk to compare software data against a lookup table of unapproved remote access software
•	Identified devices with unapproved software installations, enabling prompt removal to enhance security
•	Developed and implemented firewall rules for Palo Alto Panorama and Cisco Systems to allow routine scanning of all DMZ network segments
•	Leveraged a Linux server to execute CLI statements for Nmap, facilitating regular scanning and vulnerability assessments of DMZs, further enhancing network security
•	Earned Cribl Certified Observability Engineer User Certification and completed Splunk fundamentals 1 & 2 courses, demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning and professional development

positions.title: Personal Projects
positions.description:
Developed several iOS apps using MVC framework with UIKit and Google Firebase services 
•	ScoopMe: Created an iOS ride-sharing app, fostering safe and efficient transportation among users and their contacts
•	Honors Capstone: Designed an iOS app where users can report, monitor, and assess risks of local flooding. Provides emergency alerts to users to prevent damage, injury, and loss of life due to flooding disasters. (Pending publication in a GIS Journal)
•	Fludz™:  Enhanced the Capstone project into a business and selected as a finalist for presentation at Monmouth University’s Entrepreneurship Institute HawkTank contest. Business model proposes revenue generation from consumer and business subscribers, and ads. Uses cloud-based REST API service and GIS database to store and perform geo location-based data collection and search. Selected for Dean’s Award of Excellence in Undergraduate Research at the School of Science Research Conference.
•	MARCO Portal: Developed an iOS app for the Monmouth University Urban Coast institute to display their Mid-Atlantic Ocean Data Portal data using REST API service. Selected for Dean’s Award of Excellence in Undergraduate Research at the School of Science Research Conference. Presented at annual MARCO conference in May 2023.

PATENT
•	A Provisional U.S. Patent has been filed for Fludz service as: “A COLLECTION, DISTRIBUTION AND ANALYSIS METHODOLOGY FOR REALTIME AND HISTORICAL GIS DATA"
